pipeline_probe.note: The probe is the REAL suite under test/ (api + cross-tenant + erasure). The canonical spec string is 'node --test test/'; on Node >=20/24 the bare directory spec resolves test/ as a single module and throws MODULE_NOT_FOUND, so ci.sh executes the documented directory-glob equivalent 'node --test test/**/*.test.mjs', which runs every file in test/. No secret values are declared here; the suite injects short tenant tokens from env.
